title: The training export is gone
requirement: The engine has no export of its incidents for model training, and nothing it writes lands in the user's Downloads folder.
observed_gap: A training export (pulse-app/src/training_export.rs, the storage.export_for_training route) writes the incident corpus as a file under ~/Downloads, one of three places the product writes outside its data dir.
acceptance: The tree contains no training export and no command or route of the engine produces one; a run of the full remaining gate leaves nothing written under the user's Downloads folder; the security master lists the places the engine writes outside its data dir without it.
